meta.title: Prompt boost
meta.description: Adds an enhance button to the composer tool row: pick a persona (product, engineer, ops, data, design, marketing, content, project, finance, sales, legal, coach, custom, or auto), then rewrite the draft in that seat's style with your saved context; the context is editable in the menu and kept in this browser only. One-click revert to the draft it replaced.

title: Enhance prompt
revertHint: Restore the draft from before the enhancement
personaHint: What this request needs, not just how it is worded
contextHint: Sent with every enhancement so the rewrite can fill in your defaults. Stored in this browser only.
